description: This file contains unit tests for the HostEnvSanitizer module, testing functions related to sanitizing and inspecting environment variable overrides in different contexts.

classes.name: HostEnvSanitizerTests
classes.description: A struct containing test methods for the HostEnvSanitizer module.

methods.name: sanitize blocks shell trace variables
methods.description: Tests that certain environment variables are removed when sanitized, especially in shell trace mode.

methods.name: sanitize shell wrapper allows only explicit override keys
methods.description: Tests that only explicitly permitted keys are retained when sanitizing with a shell wrapper.

methods.name: sanitize non shell wrapper keeps regular overrides
methods.description: Verifies that overrides are preserved when not using a shell wrapper.

methods.name: inspect overrides rejects blocked and invalid keys
methods.description: Checks that the inspection function correctly identifies blocked and invalid environment variable keys.

methods.name: sanitize accepts Windows-style override key names
methods.description: Ensures that Windows-style environment variable names are accepted and preserved during sanitization.
